podcast.body: Craig Fuller, a co-founder of Pure Prairie League, wrote this song. He downplayed its significance, describing it as "just a song" and "an exercise in song craftsmanship," despite its eventual success and impact. "Many years later no matter how much the interviewer for the Tennessee and newspaper tried to make the song into a story Craig Fuller pretty much just said it's just a song."
